login.hero_desc: Chats, campaigns and contacts stay together, so nobody hunts for context.
login.feat1_desc: Assign, reply and hand over chats without losing the thread.
login.feat2_desc: Reach many contacts at once with pacing and delivery tracking.
login.feat3_desc: Route, reply and follow up with flows you design yourself.
login.feat4_desc: Roles, permissions and audit trails keep every workspace in check.
login.footer: Protected by encrypted storage and two-factor sign-in.

register.hero_desc: Set up your workspace first and choose a plan when you are ready.
register.feat1_desc: Name your workspace, set your time zone and you are in.
register.feat2_desc: Invite colleagues and give each one exactly the access they need.
register.feat3_desc: Link your messaging numbers and start talking to customers.
register.feat4_desc: Two-factor sign-in and session controls protect every account.
register.footer: No spam. You can leave any time.

forgot.hero_desc: We email a secure link that works a single time and expires soon.
